title: Prepare Lumiose Atlas logo sharing card and safe IONOS subdomain
consolidation_note: Preserve existing LA compass social-sharing metadata objective and optional IONOS subdomain plan as future/deferred; current direction keeps original Workspace origin. Do not change DNS, hosting, canonical origin or Stream Bandit.
original_pr_description:
## Goal
Make the reconstructed Pokémon guide share with its **existing Lumiose Atlas LA compass logo** and an accurate descriptive write-up, while preparing a low-risk home under Stream Bandit's IONOS domain.

## Changes
- Update the shared source template **and** generated homepage with Open Graph / Twitter social metadata.
- Keep the recovered `atlas-logo.png` (512 × 512), referenced by an absolute HTTPS URL currently pointing at the GitHub Pages preview. The image and source logo itself are unchanged.
- Set meaningful preview title, site name, description and accessible image alt text. Preserve the `noindex,nofollow` staging directive and all page content.
- Add a staged IONOS setup guide in `docs/hosting/IONOS_GUIDE_SUBDOMAIN_PLAN.md`.

## Confirmed domain evidence
The separate `trevieisking/stream-bandit` repository has a `CNAME` declaring `chatterfriendsstreambandit.co.uk`. We propose **`guide.chatterfriendsstreambandit.co.uk`** using an IONOS DNS `CNAME` to `trevieisking.github.io`, configured in the Pokémon repo's GitHub Pages settings **when released**. We have not confirmed whether the hostname is unused or that IONOS is the authoritative DNS host.

## Safe scope
- Draft PR only: **no merge, deployment, DNS changes, redirect, old ChatGPT Site change, Supabase connection/write or Stream Bandit repo change**.
- The exact legacy `chatgpt.site` link cannot be reassigned using IONOS DNS; keep original published until an optional editor-controlled redirect becomes possible.
- After the proper custom address is live, update the Open Graph image and canonical URL to that address and check with Meta Sharing Debugger. Sharing appearance is not guaranteed before a crawler test.
